completions.reason: The patient has clear evidence of Neonatal Lupus and also developed Congenital Heart Block, which is a known complication of Neonatal Lupus.
support_spans: His mother had systemic lupus erythematosus treated with hydroxychloroquine and low-dose prednisolone and was positive for anti-SSa/Ro and anti-SSb/La antibodies.
antibody testing confirmed high-titer antinuclear antibodies (>1:1000) and 52-kD anti-SSa/Ro and anti-SSb/La positivity.
His heart rate remained between 60 and 100 bpm
A permanent pacemaker was placed on day 50
